The '''Aur Diamonds''' was a collection of objects made out of [[Diamond/Legends|diamond]] that was situated in the<ref name="Author's Cut" /> [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies']]<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Aur system/Legends|Aur system]]. It consisted of [[Aur IX]] and [[Aur X]], which were spheres the size of terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|worlds]], and a [[Aur system diamond cloud|cloud]] of tumbling diamond fragments. They occupied the ninth, tenth, and eleventh [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] positions in the [[Star system/Legends|star system]], respectively. The creation of the Aur Diamonds was widely attributed to members of the [[Celestial/Legends|Celestial]] [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="Author's Cut" /> which had disappeared from [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by [[30,000 BBY]].<ref name="30,000 BBY" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Aur Diamonds were originally meant to be mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]; however, the sidebar that would have mentioned the objects was cut before the book's release. The information regarding the Aur Diamonds was later released in [[2013]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and [[Del Rey]] editor [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''.<ref name="Author's Cut" />
